1.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial has divided US on whether she's victim or criminal
1.summary: Some say the case shed light on the mental health struggles of mothers, while others argue it's no excuse for murder.

2.title: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
2.summary: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations.

3.title: What Will Happen to Lindsay Clancy in the Long Term?
3.summary: Even as a jury failed to reach a verdict in Lindsay Clancy’s murder trial, her future is unlikely to include freedom, at least for a long time. But Americans have been divided over the goal of her confinement.

4.title: Trump envoys arrive in Moscow ahead of Ukraine talks, reports say
4.summary: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are due to hold talks with Russia before travelling to Ukraine on Sunday.

5.title: Here Is Where Ukraine Peace Talks Stand, as a New Round Approaches
5.summary: A deadly campaign of Russian and Ukrainian airstrikes has escalated since the last U.S.-brokered negotiations stalled in February.

6.title: Trump Envoys Arrive in Moscow for Talks on Ukraine War
6.summary: Steve Witkoff, President Trump’s special envoy, and Jared Kushner, his son-in-law, plan to visit Kyiv next, in an effort to revive peace negotiations between Russia and Ukraine.
